title: Serve preflight executor
description: Runs before `nx serve <app>` (the composer depends on it, with the serve's own flags forwarded). Nx runs ONE `<app>:serve` per workspace and makes a second invocation WAIT on the first — then report success without having served anything. When this workspace's Nx already serves the app, this names the running stack (offset, pid, URL, owner) and either refuses a request for a different stack (--port-offset / --worktree), printing the `tools/dev/dev serve` command that starts it beside the running one, or says that this run attaches to the running stack (what an e2e target depending on `serve` wants).

project.description: The served app. Defaults to the project this target is attached to.

portOffset.description: Forwarded from `nx serve` — the stack the run asks for.

worktree.description: Forwarded from `nx serve` — the tree the run asks for.
